connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: A connection to a SOAP server
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 連接到 SOAP 伺服器的連線

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: SOAP Connection
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: SOAP 連線

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Send SOAP requests as MTOM/XOP packages: `base64Binary` content of at least `mtom_threshold` octets travels as binary MIME parts instead of base64 text, which shortens large document and image uploads. MTOM responses are always accepted.
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 將 SOAP 請求以 MTOM/XOP 套件傳送：`base64Binary` 內容至少 `mtom_threshold` 個位元組會以二進位 MIME 部分傳輸，而非 base64 文字，可縮短大型文件和影像上傳。MTOM 回應一律接受。

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: MTOM Requests
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: MTOM 請求

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Send requests as MTOM/XOP packages
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 以 MTOM/XOP 套件傳送請求

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The minimum size in octets of `base64Binary` content sent as a binary MTOM part; `0` sends every value as a part. Applies only when `mtom` is `True`.
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 以二進位 MTOM 部分傳送的 `base64Binary` 內容最小大小（以八位組計）；`0` 會將所有值都作為部分傳送。僅當 `mtom` 為 `True` 時才適用。

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: MTOM Part Threshold
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: MTOM 部分閾值

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The smallest binary value sent as an MTOM part
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 以 MTOM 部分傳送的最小二進位值

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Send the `SOAPAction` HTTP header with SOAP 1.1 requests, as SOAP 1.1 and the WS-I Basic Profile require. Set to `False` only for a server that rejects the header; requests using WS-Addressing always carry it.
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 針對 SOAP 1.1 請求傳送 `SOAPAction` HTTP 標頭，依 SOAP 1.1 與 WS-I 基本範本要求。僅在伺服器拒絕該標頭時才設為 `False`；使用 WS-Addressing 的請求一律會攜帶此標頭。

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Send SOAPAction
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 傳送 SOAPAction

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Send the SOAPAction header with SOAP 1.1 requests
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 針對 SOAP 1.1 請求傳送 SOAPAction 標頭

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The name of the SOAP service to use (if more than 1 service is defined in the WSDL then this key is mandatory
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 要用的 SOAP 服務名稱（若 WSDL 中定義多個服務，則此鍵為必要）

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: SOAP Service
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: SOAP 服務

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The name of the SOAP service to use
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 要用的 SOAP 服務名稱

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: In case multiple port entries are found in the WSDL, give the one to be used here
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 如果 WSDL 中找到多個端點項目，請在此指定要使用的項目

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: SOAP Port
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: SOAP 端點

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The SOAP port to use
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 要使用的 SOAP 端點

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Any message body to send when performing an advanced ping operation; ignored if either one of `ping_method` and `ping_path` are not set or if `ping_method` is `GET`
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 執行進階 Ping 操作時要傳送的任何訊息本文；若 `ping_method` 和 `ping_path` 其中之一未設定，或 `ping_method` 為 `GET`，則會被忽略

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Ping Body
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: Ping 本文

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The message body to send with pings
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 隨 ping 發送的訊息內文

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Any HTTP headers to send when performing an advanced ping operation; ignored if either one of `ping_method` and `ping_path` are not set
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 執行進階 ping 操作時發送的任何 HTTP 標頭；如果 `ping_method` 和 `ping_path` 中有任一個未設定，則忽略此項目

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Ping Headers
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: Ping 標頭

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Any HTTP headers to send with pings
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 隨 ping 發送的任何 HTTP 標頭

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The HTTP method to use for an advanced ping; this and `ping_path` must be set to make an HTTP request as a part of the socket polling ping operation; must be a valid HTTP method name
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 用於進階 ping 的 HTTP 方法；必須設定此項與 `ping_path`，才能在通訊端輪詢 ping 操作中發出 HTTP 請求；必須是有效的 HTTP 方法名稱

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Ping Method
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: Ping 方法

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The HTTP method to use for pings
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 用於 ping 的 HTTP 方法

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The URI path to use for an advanced ping; this and `ping_method` must be set to make an HTTP request as a part of the socket polling ping operation.  If the value for this option begins with a `/` character, then it replaces any connection path for the SOAP client, otherwise the value is appended to the connection path for the SOAP client.
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 用於進階 ping 的 URI 路徑；此項與 `ping_method` 必須同時設定，才能在 socket 輪詢 ping 操作中發出 HTTP 請求。如果此選項的值以 `/` 字元開頭，則會取代 SOAP 客戶端的連接路徑；否則，該值會附加至 SOAP 客戶端的連接路徑。

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Ping Path
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: Ping 路徑

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The URI path to use for pings
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 用於 ping 的 URI 路徑

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Overrides the WSDL URL provided by the connection URL
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 覆蓋連接 URL 提供的 WSDL URL

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: WSDL URL
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: WSDL URL

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: The URL for the WSDL
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: WSDL 的 URL

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Overrides the URL in the WSDL
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 覆蓋 WSDL 中的 URL

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Override URL
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 覆蓋 URL

connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.source: Overrides the URL in the WSDL
connection.U29hcENsaWVudA.scheme.U29hcEN.message: 覆蓋 WSDL 中的 URL
